title: Contrastive belief-update measurement of reward-seeking on public Qwen2.5 models
description: The paper's contrastive-SDF measurement and all controls port cleanly to Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B. The style-preference effect was not observed (7B: beliefs fail to bind at behavior-preserving doses; 32B: tight null with preconditions met), but the honesty-vs-task-completion effect reproduces qualitatively at small effect size: grader-ward forced-choice shift +4.3 nats at 7B (n.s.), +9.9 at 14B (n=10 seed pairs, t=5.4), +5.0 at 32B (n=3).
